settings.heading: Magic
settings.body: A gift of any size keeps the LeMoyne-Owen Magicians on the course. 100% goes straight to the program, gear, travel, and the next round.

settings.heading: Pick a Level

settings.footnote: Prefer to give monthly or a custom amount? Email dominique_worthen@loc.edu.

settings.body:
Travel, vans, hotels, and entry fees so the team can compete anywhere.

Gear, clubs, balls, bags, and apparel for every player on the roster.

Future, pathways into golf careers through PGA programs and mentorship.
